entries.text: The SQLGlot runtime baseline check (`make sqlglot-repro-retirement-check`) now runs the `questdb` case on a QuestDB endpoint named by `BENCHBOX_QUESTDB_DSN`; the CI lint job starts a QuestDB service for it. DuckDB `ORDER BY ALL`, `EXTRACT` of an input of unknown type on SQLite, and the QuestDB dialect now pass directly through the runtime.
